scope: Exact main-meridian scalar and preferred-cusp identity for marked Conway constructions; geometric first correction for the existing long-twist moving-meridian class.
proved: The prescribed crossing, turn and zero-framing scalars combine exactly to q_N^((-w(D)-sum_i n_i)s^2/2).
Original meridian-normalized face maps and the homology of disk fillings give the preferred cusp shape tau=-w(D)-sum_i n_i+2i sum_e cot(pi x_e^fill).
For the existing moving-meridian class, the first correction after the exact sine quotient is pi i s^2 tau/(2N), uniformly on |s|<=R<1.
The normalized reduced profile tends to sin(pi s)/(pi s); the normalized full modified-trace profile tends to one.
limits: The geometric identity has broader strict-tree scope than the moving asymptotic. This release does not enlarge that asymptotic class, cross ordinary-color resonances, or identify a classical geometric A-factor.
pyramid_caption: Schematic hyperbolic pyramid; quadrilateral gluing face.
